title: Reomte Sales Representative
description:
Responsibilities

* Conduct cold outreach through outbound phone calls, emails and messages.
* Follow outreach scripts while keeping conversations natural and professional.
* Ask relevant questions to understand prospects’ needs and assess their interest.
* Follow up with interested prospects and arrange appointments or callbacks.
* Answer basic questions and pass relevant information to the team.
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, conversations and follow-up actions.
* Work towards agreed outreach goals and provide regular progress updates.

What we’re looking for

* Clear, confident verbal and written communication.
* A friendly, professional manner and confidence speaking with new people.
* Comfort making cold calls and handling rejection politely.
* Strong organisation, reliability and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow instructions, work independently and manage time effectively.
* Familiarity with email, spreadsheets and basic online tools.
* Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing or lead generation is an advantage.
